# logos nogo cache and offline bootstrap: helper/source/module-lock inputs,
# policy and --json-diagnostics in the action ID, persistent helper cache,
# and offline prebuilt proof with no silent clean.
# printf uses a local formatf wrapper (native checks std calls only), so the
# cached lint stays helper-only.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache

mkdir $WORK/bin

# Default deny fails at the original Go line with no eject temp.
cd cache
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# A second run replays the same diagnostic: facts are temp, helper cached,
# never a false clean on a cache hit.
cd cache
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# A cache hit replays the same diagnostic, never a false clean.
cd cache
! logos lint -x ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# -n shows the per-package helper invocation shape.
cd cache
logos lint -n ./...
stderr '\-package'
stderr '\-json'
stderr '\-findings'
stderr '\-facts-output'
cd ..

# A logos.toml change invalidates the cache: warn prints and exits 0.
cd cache
cp logos-warn.toml logos.toml
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*warning: \[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# The output format is part of the action ID: JSON after text prints JSON,
# not replayed text.
cd cache
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# Text after JSON prints text again, not replayed JSON.
cd cache
logos lint ./...
stderr 'warning: \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr '^\{'
cd ..

# A stricter policy is never hidden by the cache.
cd cache
cp logos-deny.toml logos.toml
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# logos build runs no nogo, so the same package builds clean.
cd cache
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cache$GOEXE .
! stderr .
go build -o $WORK/bin/cache-go$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# Helper source input: a fresh cache still drives a complete analysis,
# never a false clean.
mkdir $WORK/cache-src
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-src
exists $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo/cmd/logos-nogo/main.go
cd cache
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# Helper module and module-lock inputs: a fresh cache still drives a
# complete analysis, never a false clean.
mkdir $WORK/cache-mod
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-mod
exists $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo/go.mod
exists $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo/go.sum
cd cache
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# Offline with no cached helper and no module cache still drives a complete
# analysis via the installed prebuilt, never silent or stale.
mkdir $WORK/emptycache
mkdir $WORK/freshcache
env GOCACHE=$WORK/freshcache
env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/emptycache
cd cache
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

-- cache/go.mod --
module example.com/cache

go 1.27

-- cache/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- cache/logos-warn.toml --
[lints]
nogo = "warn"

-- cache/logos-deny.toml --
[lints]
nogo = "deny"
